Magic 8 Ball

Ask the Magic 8 Ball anything and shake it for one of the 20 classic answers. Just for fun.

8

📖 How to use

  1. Type your yes-or-no question.
  2. Press SHAKE (or hit Enter).
  3. The ball shakes dramatically…
  4. …and reveals one of the 20 classic answers.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it actually predict the future?

No — it's a random pick from the 20 classic Magic 8 Ball answers. Pure entertainment, zero psychic ability.

What are the possible answers?

Ten affirmative, five non-committal and five negative — the same mix as the classic toy.

Is my question saved anywhere?

No. Nothing leaves your browser; the question is never stored or sent anywhere.
